description: A PNG picture of one ayah or a run of them as the Madinah Mushaf prints them: the page's own lines in its script (QCF v4), the ayahs around faded. Up to one page (15 lines). Only when the reader asks for a picture or image; for the text, use get_ayah.

to.description: Last ayah, for a run; defaults to the first
